sentences.text: Australotadorna alecwilsoni is an extinct bird belonging to the shelduck subfamily of the duck family.
The species name alecwilsoni honors Alec Wilson, a pastoral lease holder who supported fossil research on his property.
The type locality for Australotadorna is Lake Pinpa in the Lake Eyre Basin of north-eastern South Australia.
The genus Australotadorna was described by Worthy in 2009.
Australotadorna is classified within the tribe Tadornini.
Australotadorna belongs to the family Anatidae.
Australotadorna lived during the Late Oligocene epoch.
This species lived in central Australia during the Late Oligocene.
The fossil record for Australotadorna spans from 27.3 to 23.04 million years ago.
